svg.title: O2C reconciliation and governed controls design board
svg.desc: Five editable light workspace designs. Bank matching, independent approval, source import, agents with audit, and mobile reconciliation. Honest empty states; no fabricated financial records.

g.text: Match statement credits to receipts and invoices in a separate workspace.
